title: PBoC vows to maintain loose monetary policy, keep Chinese Yuan stable
summary: The People’s Bank of China (PBoC) said on Thursday that it will step up counter-cyclical adjustments and continue to implement an “appropriately loose” monetary policy, according to Reuters.

title: Euro: Downside risks start to shrink against US Dollar – ING
summary: Francesco Pesole at ING argues EUR/USD’s break below 1.140 has pushed the pair into stretched undervaluation versus their short-term fair value model, as rate differentials moved in favour of the Euro.
